title: Hand-In of Equipment Rental and Demo Kit and the Closing of an Agreement
content:
## Hand-in

Kit from the Equipment Rental and Demo line is handed in at a shop, checked by a technician and taken back into stock.

Where the package allows it, kit may be handed in at any of the collective's shops that carry the package, against the package's cross-mountain fee; where it does not, kit handed in elsewhere is moved back by the collective and the fee is raised all the same. The fee therefore stands on both sides of that line: what the package's terms decide is whether the hand-in elsewhere was open to the guest, not whether the figure is charged.

The date of hand-in is the date the kit reaches the counter, not the date the guest says they finished with it, and an after-hours drop box is treated as the next opening morning.

### Hand-in dates on hypothetical kit

| What happened | Date of hand-in |
| --- | --- |
| kit left at the counter on the 3rd | the 3rd |
| kit put in the drop box late on the 3rd, the shop opening on the 4th | the 4th |
| kit finished with on the 1st and brought to the counter on the 3rd | the 3rd |

## Closing

An agreement is closed only when nothing is left to collect on it and the security hold has been released or applied in full. Both of those are read from the collective's records for the one agreement before it is closed: the amount still to be collected on it, and the security hold standing against it.

Closing is the last thing recorded on the agreement and nothing is added to it afterwards.

## Season leases

Kit belonging to a season lease is handed in at the end of the season it was written for, and a lease handed in early is not refunded for the season remaining because the price was for the season and not for the days.

## Points of judgement

**An agreement with a figure still to be collected.** It is not closed while anything is left to collect on it, whatever else stands settled.

**An agreement whose hold has been applied in full against what was owed.** The hold has been dealt with, so that side of the test is met; what remains is that nothing is left to collect.

**A Season-Long Lease Package handed in in February for a season written to April.** The lease is not refunded for the season remaining.
